messages:
maria: Compliance needs nightly exports of routing-policy changes with 'who/when/what' and the change payload. Concern: PII leakage.
sam: default to pseudonymized actor, reversible per-tenant with salt. ask compliance for retention.
akash: per-tenant salt stored encrypted, actor_hash = sha256(user_id + salt). enterprise-only reveal API that returns email after auth. presigned links short-lived.
leah: console should show two modes: pseudonymized (default) and reveal identities (enterprise + 2-step). red banner if reveal enabled.
maria: API proposal?
sam: add fields: actor_hash, actor_revealed (bool), actor_display (nullable). bundle manifest.json should include actor_revealed, redaction_policy, rows, size_bytes, bundle_hash.
akash: presigned TTL default 24h, up to 7d for enterprise; HMAC the bundle, include checksum. emit telemetry when revealed exports occur.
leah: redaction presets per-tenant: strict/default/permissive. allow per-attribute rules (email, ip, session_id). UI should show estimated rows and egress cost before confirming.
maria: quotas: rate-limit exports per-tenant and per-user. spike detection: alert if size > 10x baseline. rollout behind flag audit_export_v3: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
sam: file layout: manifest.json + data/changes.ndjson + checksums.txt. manifest must list redaction_policy.
akash: security: do not log raw emails when redaction on. mapping reveal requires admin scope and audit entry.
leah: tests: unit redaction matrix + integration for manifest accuracy.
maria: actions: sam -> API PR, akash -> worker + salt + signing, leah -> console mocks + confirm UX, ops-bot -> schedule nightly export job and telemetry. tagging tickets now. closing thread. :thumbsup:
